Hart Array Window Select

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x50
Size:
0x4
Source:
debug_module.rdl

Description

Selects which 32-bit portion of the hart array mask register is accessible in hawindow.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:15] _reserved_31_15 r 0x0 -
[14:0] hawindowsel rw 0x0 -

Field Descriptions

_reserved_31_15

Reserved. High bits may be tied to 0 depending on hart array mask size.

hawindowsel

Window select for hart array mask register. E.g., on a system with 48 harts, only bit 0 may be writable.
